```{r setup}
library(icorp26)
library(easystats)
library(here)
```

Most of the time in research we are interested 
in understanding the relationships between variables.
That is, we want to know whether differences in one
variable are associated with differences in another
variable.

```{r}
data_tabulate(rss1$PAY_PAYWORRY, by = rss1$HIS_GENERAL)
```



```{r}
data_tabulate(rss1$CVL_DEPRESS,
              by = rss1$LONGCOVID,
              remove_na = TRUE,
              proportions = "column",
              name = "LC is Depression") |> 
     print_html()
```
